project.description: The name of the project to add the Docker build executor to.
project.x-prompt: For which project should the build executor be added?

context.description: The build context path for the Docker build process.

dockerfile.description: The path to the Dockerfile relative to the project root.

buildTarget.description: The build target from which to extract the output path.

imageSuffix.description: A suffix to add to the base Docker image name.

imageName.description: The base name of the Docker image.

command.description: The custom command to start the Docker container.

save.description: Whether to create a 'save' target in the project configuration.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files during configuration.
